concerns.text: Task T014 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it runs the full end‑to‑end pipeline (`code/run_all.py`). Executing this concurrently with any other task that reads/writes the same data directories can cause race conditions (e.g., data files being overwritten). The `[P]` tag should be removed or the task re‑designed to be truly parallel‑safe.

Task T015 is also tagged `[P]` yet it deletes the entire `data/` directory and re‑executes the pipeline. Running this in parallel with other tasks would corrupt shared artifacts. The `[P]` tag is inappropriate and should be removed.
